Action: Use a provider that deletes request data immediately after processing
Limitation: Contractual promise only; check terms before sending sensitive data

Action: Keep restricted files in a directory outside the project folder so the agent cannot open them by accident [@Brown2026book]
Limitation: You must move files yourself and manage what the agent can see

Action: Run the model on your computer so no data leave it [@Abramson2026; @Wiest2024]
Limitation: Matching hosted-model quality needs expensive high-performance hardware [@Brown2026local]

Action: Use a local model to build a synthetic dataset with the same structure and statistical properties but no real locations, measurements, or identifying information, then send the proxy to the remote model for code writing [@Schweinberger2026privacy]
Limitation: The proxy must match the variable types, distributions, and format of the real columns, or the code will not transfer
